svg.title: SpoolBuddy wiring with an optional HX711 scale board
svg.desc: HX711 VCC to Pi physical pin 17 (3.3V), GND to pin 6, DT to pin 29 (GPIO5), SCK to pin 31 (GPIO6). PN5180 connections: 5V pin 2, 3V3 pin 1, reset pin 18, NSS pin 16, MOSI pin 19, MISO pin 21, clock pin 23, busy pin 22, ground pin 20. Load-cell excitation to E+ and E-, signal to A+ and A-. Wire colors vary by load cell.

g.text: Physical header pin numbers shown beside each contact
